text.p: Newcastle thrashed Manchester United 5-0 on Sunday to go top of the English premier league and avenge their recent bitter defeats by their big rivals.
Defender Darren Peacock opened the scoring with a disputed header after 12 minutes and Frenchman David Ginola added a brilliant second before the interval.

England strikers Les Ferdinand and Alan Shearer scored Newcastle's third and fourth goals, and Belgian Philippe Albert rounded off the victory with a fine lob. The day's other big match -- the Merseyside derby between Liverpool and Everton -- was postponed because of heavy overnight and morning rain which left the Anfield pitch waterlogged.
